method.coordinates: WGS84 -> sample-centred azimuthal equidistant PROJ metre CRS; no global Web Mercator or degree-to-metre conversion.
method.nativeVertices: Stored chain vertices, including window cut endpoints; independent of distance sampling.
method.distanceSampling: Uniform projected arc length, both directions, 100m then 50m convergence check; native-vertex average not used.
method.turnSampling: Uniform 1km maximum step; actual equal step reported; absolute turns measured between successive sampled chords.
method.anchors: Identical geographic bounding window for both sources; longest connected intersecting shared chain, fixed transverse cuts. Endpoint displacements reported, not snapped away. Multiple-component samples require explicit correspondence review.
method.uncertainty: Source edition, registration, river movement and political interpretation may contribute; LSIB 11.4 is not a legal/historical accuracy oracle. No tolerance inferred from mean displacement or vertex density.
